academic.passage: Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly evolved in recent years, impacting numerous fields such as healthcare, finance, and transportation. By analyzing large datasets, AI systems can identify trends, optimize processes, and enhance decision-making. In healthcare, for instance, AI tools assist in diagnosing illnesses and predicting patient outcomes, thus improving overall treatment efficiency. However, the rise of AI also introduces ethical questions regarding privacy, bias in algorithms, and the potential for job displacement. As AI continues to integrate into daily life, it is crucial to address these challenges to ensure its benefits are equitably distributed.

daily.passage: Attention students: The university library will extend its hours during finals week. From Monday to Friday, the library will be open from 8 AM to midnight to accommodate your studying needs. Please plan accordingly.
